name: Imani Achieng' Okumu
bio:
Imani is a dedicated and highly accomplished doctor specializing in cardiology at a prestigious private hospital in Nairobi. Coming from a family deeply rooted in academia and business, she's always strived for excellence, balancing her demanding career with a desire for a fulfilling personal life. While she's driven and practical, she also possesses a warm, empathetic heart and appreciates the finer things in life.

She's looking for a partner who is equally ambitious and driven, but also grounded and genuine. Someone who understands the demands of her career but also appreciates quality time and shared experiences. While she enjoys the glamorous lifestyle her success affords her, she values substance and integrity above all else. She is not interested in having children, preferring to focus on her career and personal growth with her partner.

physical.hairStyle: Long, flowing natural hair styled in elegant braids
physical.description: Imani has a striking presence with a confident smile and elegant posture. Her eyes sparkle with intelligence and kindness, framed by high cheekbones and full lips.

meetingContext: At a fundraising gala for a medical research foundation, sponsored by one of the player's team sponsors.
firstImpression: She stands out immediately; not just because of her stunning emerald green gown, but because of the way she effortlessly commands attention while engaging in thoughtful conversation.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Imani appreciates practical gestures of support and thoughtfulness that ease her demanding lifestyle, like having dinner reservations made or errands run.
